data_description.off_mode: Auto keeps the light reacting to detections at night. Off disables it.
data_description.motion_timeout: Seconds a motion sensor stays on after a detection.
data_description.scan_interval: Seconds between status updates. Netatmo allows about 500 requests per hour.
data_description.use_webhook: Needs Home Assistant reachable from the internet over HTTPS on port 443, or Home Assistant Cloud. Without it, events are polled.
